featured_reviews.review_text:
Somewhat hidden away across from the bustling Regal Circle, Avante is easily missed.  We started going there because of their lovely camel bone boxes, which have become a staple present for friends.

The tiled floor is an artwork in its own right.  There's a nice variety of handicrafts without being too overwhelming.

featured_reviews.review_text: The prices here are so reasonable, the art is beautiful and everyone is so friendly.  Haseena is wonderful and so helpful.

featured_reviews.review_text: Great place to buy Indian jewellery and knick knacks! Have been coming for many years. Definitely must check out if you're looking to gift friends and family or decorate your home :)

featured_reviews.name: Vinesh Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avante Cottage Crafts was an A++++ experience.  Every time I look at the pieces I purchased, I not only remember my trip to Mumbai, but also the great shopping experience the staff provided.

The Pieces: The large selection of high quality pieces made it a one-stop shop for me.  I walked away with pieces that range from classical to modern, enhance any room, and make for great conversation.  I was most impressed with the wood-pressed painting and silk tapestries I purchased for my home.

The Staff: The staff is absolutely dedicated to service and ensuring you'll have a great experience.  They personally select the items they stock, and it shows in the way they help you.  Once the team knew more about my home and the aesthetic I was looking for, they were able to quickly pick out items I would like - explaining the origin, workmanship, and significance of each piece.  They even suggested ways to best display the pieces as an ensemble.

Shipping: Packaging and shipping were also very easy.  I decided not to ship the items so they were hand-delivered to my hotel room - free of charge (although I did tip).  Each piece was wrapped in bubble tape and styrofoam, and individually boxed.  I arrived home with showroom quality pieces and immediately put them on display.

Bottom line: I'll happily return on my next visit, and think you'll have as great an experience as I did.  The store is easy to find near the Regal Cinema; the selection of pieces are amazing; and the helpful staff is even better.

featured_reviews.name: radhai Meenakshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Review for Silbatta Purchase from Ghori Décor

I had been searching for a silbatta for a long time, but it wasn’t available anywhere around my localities in Chennai. While searching online, I came across Ghori Décor on IndiaMART, and got in touch with Mr. Nadeem Ghori from Mumbai. I had a few customizations in mind, and he patiently listened and informed me that the product was in Rajasthan, and he would be able to check when he traveled there the next month.

Honestly, I lost hope, thinking I might never hear back. But to my surprise, Mr. Nadeem remembered me and followed up in mid-March, sending me exactly the piece I had been looking for since February. I was truly amazed at his sincerity and commitment. Due to personal health reasons, I couldn’t respond promptly, yet he reminded me again with so much patience and care.

Finally, in August, he managed to send me the silbatta through parcel service. One piece arrived in perfect condition, while another was slightly damaged. When I informed him, he immediately took full responsibility and didn’t even charge me for the damaged piece — something that is truly rare to see in today’s world. He only took the payment for the perfect piece and the courier charges.

This experience has been more than just a purchase — it was about trust, humanity, and genuine customer service. Every time I see my silbatta, I feel grateful for Mr. Nadeem Ghori, even though we have never met in person. In 2025, it is rare to find someone who values service and relationships above money, and I feel blessed to have come across such a person.

Highly recommend Ghori Décor for their honesty, quality, and heartfelt service. 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Sky & Patty Williamson
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the good fortune of finding Natesan’s beautiful collection a few years ago and was delighted to return on my recent visit to Mumbai in March 2026.  The showroom is two levels, a beautifully curated display of original antiquities for viewing on the first floor and an equally beautiful and intriguing display of finest quality reproductions and non antique vintage pieces available for purchase on the second floor.  The collection was quite diverse with brass and bronze hindu statues, wood carved pieces, and artwork - stunning.  A wide range of sizes and pricepoints are also available and at good value given the very high quality of the pieces.  I had a wonderful discussion of the various pieces with Pushpa who was very charming and extremely knowledgeable about the history and artistic styles.  This is a no pressure environment and i would have viewed the visit alone as a highpoint, though i was thrilled to take home a beautiful Kerala mural.  Pushpa was very helpful in talking through the transport options and it was a seamless and easy transaction.  Definitely make a visit to Natesan’s a priority on your next Mumbai visit.  Cheers! Patty

featured_reviews.name: anjitha mekkayil anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
Phillips Antiques, nestled in the heart of Mumbai's heritage district near Colaba, is more than just a shop; it's a living museum steeped in history. Established in 1860, this family-owned establishment is one of the oldest antique stores in the city, and stepping inside feels like a journey back in time.
The carefully curated collection is a treasure trove of colonial-era finds and exquisite pieces from across Asia. From magnificent carved wooden furniture – beds, armchairs, settees, and marble-topped tables – to delicate Victorian curios, gilded mirrors, and religious statues, every item tells a story. You'll find a fascinating array of lamps, lithographs, old maps, and photographs of pre-Independence Bombay, offering a nostalgic glimpse into the city's past.
The true charm of Phillips Antiques lies not just in its impressive inventory, but also in the passion and knowledge of its proprietors. They are more like curators, happy to share the provenance and significance of each piece, making the Browse experience educational and truly captivating. While the prices reflect the rarity and quality of the items, even if you're not in the market to buy, a visit to Phillips Antiques is a must for anyone with an appreciation for history, art, and the unique allure of old-world charm in modern Mumbai.
